source.title: Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible
source.author: Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown
source.edition: CCEL expanded electronic edition of the 1871 public-domain text

entries.heading: 2. useth . . . aright
entries.text: 2. useth . . . aright --commends knowledge by its proper use. poureth out --utters abundantly ( Pr 12:23 ), and so disgusts others.

entries.heading: 3. beholding
entries.text: 3. beholding --watching (compare Pr 5:21; Ps 66:7 ).

entries.heading: 4. A wholesome tongue
entries.text: 4. A wholesome tongue --(Compare Margin ), pacifying and soothing language. tree of life -- ( Pr 3:18; 11:30 ). perverseness therein --cross, ill-natured language. breach . . . spirit --(compare Isa 65:14 , Hebrew ), grieves, instead of appeasing.
5. (Compare Pr 4:1; 10:17; 13:1-18 ). is prudent --acts discreetly.

entries.heading: 6. treasure
entries.text: 6. treasure --implying utility. trouble --vexation and affliction.
7. (Compare Pr 10:20, 21 ). heart . . . not so --not right, or vain.

entries.heading: 8, 9. The sacrifice
entries.text: 8, 9. The sacrifice [and] prayer --are acts of worship. way . . . followeth . . . righteousness --denote conduct. God's regard for the worship and deeds of the righteous and wicked respectively, so stated in Ps 50:17; Isa 1:11 .
10. (Compare Pr 10:17 ). the way --that in which God would have him to go ( Pr 2:13; Ps 119:1 ).

entries.heading: 11. Hell
entries.text: 11. Hell -- ( Ps 16:10 ). destruction --or, "Abaddon," the place of the destroyer. All the unseen world is open to God, much more men's hearts.
12. (Compare Pr 9:8 ). go unto the wise --to be instructed.

entries.heading: 13. maketh . . . countenance
entries.text: 13. maketh . . . countenance --or, "benefits the countenance." spirit is broken --and so the countenance is sad.
14. (Compare Pr 10:21, 22 ). The wise grow wiser, the fools more foolish ( Pr 9:9 ).
15. The state of the heart governs the outward condition. evil --sad, contrasted with the cheerfulness of a feast.

entries.heading: 16. trouble
entries.text: 16. trouble --agitation, implying the anxieties and perplexities attending wealth held by worldlings ( Pr 16:18; 1Ti 6:6 ).

entries.heading: 17. dinner
entries.text: 17. dinner --or, "allowance" ( 2Ki 25:30 ) -- of herbs --and that the plainest. and hatred --(compare Pr 10:12, 18 ).
19. The difficulties of the slothful result from want of energy; the righteous find a plain [and open] way --literally, "a highway," by diligence ( 1Sa 10:7; Ps 1:3 ).
20. (Compare Pr 10:1 ).

entries.heading: 21. walketh uprightly
entries.text: 21. walketh uprightly --and so finds his joy ( Pr 3:6; 10:23 ).

entries.heading: 22. Without counsel
entries.text: 22. Without counsel --or, "deliberation," implying a wise deference to the opinions of the wise and good, contrasted with rashness.
23. Good advice blesses the giver and receiver.
24. (Compare Col 3:2 ). Holy purposes prevent sinning, and so its evils.
25. The most desolate who have God's aid have more permanent good than the self-reliant sinner ( Pr 2:22; 12:7 ). border --or, "boundary for possessions" ( Ps 78:54 ).

entries.heading: 26. are pleasant words
entries.text: 26. are pleasant words --that is, pleasing to God ( Pr 8:8, 9 ).
27. (Compare Pr 11:17 ). Avarice brings trouble to him and his. hateth gifts --or, "bribes" ( Ex 23:8; Ps 15:5 ), and is not avaricious.
28. (Compare Pr 15:14; 10:11 ). Caution is the fruit of wisdom; rashness of folly.

entries.heading: 29. far . . . wicked
entries.text: 29. far . . . wicked --in His love and favor ( Ps 22:11; 119:155 ).

entries.heading: 30. light of the eyes
entries.text: 30. light of the eyes -- ( Pr 13:9 ). What gives light rejoiceth the heart, by relieving from anxiety as to our course; so good report --or, "doctrine" ( Isa 28:9; 53:1 ), maketh . . . fat --or, "gives prosperity" ( Pr 3:13-17; 9:11 ). The last clause is illustrated by the first.
31, 32. (Compare Pr 10:17 ). reproof of life --which leads to life. abideth . . . wise --is numbered among them.

entries.heading: 32. refuseth
entries.text: 32. refuseth --or, "neglects," "passes by" ( Pr 1:25; 4:15 ). despiseth . . . soul --so acts as if esteeming its interests of no value.

entries.heading: 33. The fear . . . wisdom
entries.text: 33. The fear . . . wisdom --Wisdom instructs in true piety. before . . . humility --(compare Lu 24:26; 1Pe 1:11 ); opposite (compare Pr 16:18 ).
